1. (Currently amended) A golf tee comprising a long lasting combination of a golf tee and a force absorbing member in association therewith, said tee including a ground insertion end, a ball support end and a shaft in between, said member surrounding said shaft and being located below said ball support end and having an outer diameter less than that of a golf ball but large enough and located so as to protect said support end from impact from a golf club strike after a golf ball has been struck from said tee, wherein __said force absorbing member is fixedly attached to said shaft and is not slidable along the length of said shaft__.

2. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a material that enables the shaft to withstand damage from a strike on the resilient member __and said force absorbing member is bonded to said shaft__.

3. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a member selected from the group consisting of __composite materials, reinforced plastics, and__ wood, plastic and metal.

4. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a hardwood __having a density greater than 0.75 g/cm³__.

5. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from an engineering plastic __selected from the group consisting of polyetheretherketone (PEEK), polyimide, and polyphenylene sulfide (PPS)__.

6. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 5, wherein said tee is formed from a polycarbonate __blended with a UV-stabilizing additive__.

7. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from nylon __with a reinforcing fiber content of at least 20% by weight__.

8. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a malleable metal __selected from the group consisting of titanium alloys and magnesium alloys__.

9. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 8, wherein said tee is formed from aluminum __alloy 6061-T6 or 7075-T6__.

10. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 9, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising a natural or man-made material __and is chemically bonded to said aluminum tee__.

11. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising a natural or man-made material __and is permanently affixed to said shaft through vulcanization or adhesive bonding__.

12. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 11, wherein said force absorbing material has a hardness of from about 30 to about 90 durometer __and exhibits a compression set of less than 25% after 70 hours at 70°C__.

13. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 12, wherein said force absorbing material comprises a neoprene having a hardness of from about 50 to about 60 durometer __and a tensile strength of at least 2 MPa__.

14. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 11, wherein said force absorbing material comprises a neoprene __with a minimum tensile strength of 2 MPa and elongation at break of at least 200%__.
